purpose: LOCAL OWNER DEMO ONLY — disposable local database. Never applied to staging or production (the seed refuses non-local DATABASE_URL hosts).
notes: appointments=true permits appointment REQUEST records only; confirmation still requires staff or a verified scheduler.
uploads=true enables local Inbox file attach; SKIPPED scans are attachable only when NODE_ENV!==production (no malware scanner).
Hours are synthetic (storeHoursVerifiedBy=synthetic-demo) and are labeled 'demo hours' to the customer; production treats them as unverified.
Inventory rows use source=synthetic_demo, VINs that contain the letter O (impossible in a real VIN), no photos; production reads exclude them.
Financial policy stays ILLUSTRATIVE: no tax/fee rules, so out-the-door totals route to staff instead of being guessed.
